title: 第155章 驴统治世界第154章 他只能阿巴阿巴
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
“当初谷主因为没有救下那些变成傀儡的弟子们，心中一直很内疚，几百年来，一直在研制这种邪药的解药。”
“如果药王谷里有人在练邪药，那谷主不可能没发现。”
宁楚想了想后问：“药尊，你说，有没有一种可能，就是药王谷某一个人因为心术不正，被赶出了药王谷，但他之前阴差阳错得到了这种邪药的药方。”
“离开药王谷之后就开始练这种药，最后让他给练成了？”
裴昭若有所思地点点头，他觉得很有道理，“不对不对，中间还有一段。”
“这个人离开药王谷后辗转去了靖兰，我父皇拜他为国师。”
“他想用我来炼丹，但没成功，他逃离靖兰之后才开始练这种邪药。”
在这个人去靖兰时，肯定没有练邪药的，否则整个靖兰恐怕早就沦陷了。
听两人这么说，作为药王谷人的云栖都要相信这种猜测了。
但他真的什么都不知道，三百年来有没有人被赶出药王谷，有几个，他一无所知。
他从储物袋里掏出一张传音符，抬手做了个暂停讨论的手势，转身就走，“稍等，容我问一问。”
云栖向角落走去，开始联系药王谷谷主。
其他人都各自找地方坐了下来，在众人都一脸沉重的时候，只有裴昭最看得开，也玩得开。
仗着现在谁都碰不到自己，他围着顾玄转了一圈，拍拍他的屁股，虽然只拍到了空气，但他不亦乐乎。
拍完之后又飘到厚朴面前想拽他的胡子，动作光明正大，弄得厚朴眼神划出一个睿智的‘Z’型，也不知是该生气还是该笑。
平时要是有人敢碰他的胡子，他绝对要跳着脚骂人的。
但现在的裴昭嘛，算了算了。
随他去吧，反正他也没真的碰到。
裴昭玩够了厚朴，又胆大包天地飘到了宁雄霸面前，跃跃欲试。
宁雄霸眯了眯眼，他一抖，又飘回了秦玖身边，弱弱地躲在她身后。

算鸟算鸟，还是不能太大逆不道。
殿中众人看着他这般，心里纷纷觉得好笑，一直萦绕在他们头顶的乌云好像消散了一些。
果然还得是裴昭啊，跟宁楚一样的厚脸皮。
即便是死了也还是如此，他们还得跟他学习。
看着他这样，原本因为他死了的悲伤心情都好了不少。
爱咋咋地吧，至少他还在他们面前玩闹，不是吗。
但这个仇必须要报，一定要报，谁也拦不住他们。
正如此想着，门外突然冲进来一人，宝儿怒气冲冲地喊：“云栖呢？！”
“让他给我滚出来！”
她被下了药，一觉睡到现在，精神好了许多，但嗓子依旧沙哑。
“给我下药是什么意思？他想死吗？！”
“我可以成全他！”
她提着剑，恨不得一剑砍了云栖，居然用这种下三滥的手段来对付她。
混蛋。
听见宝儿的喊声，几人齐齐抬头看去，宁雄霸沉下脸色，“是我让他给你下药的，你有意见？”
她那个状态，他们怎么可能放任不管，下药就是最快最好的办法。
这不，睡了一觉起来，声音都大了不少。
宝儿被父亲一噎，憋闷在胸腔的怒气无处发泄。
她挥了两下剑，音量不减反增，“就算，就算是这样，你们也不能直接给我下药！你们都不尊重我的意见！”
content_en:
"The Valley Master has been feeling guilty for not saving the disciples who turned into puppets. He has been developing an antidote to this evil medicine for hundreds of years."
"If someone in Yaowang Valley is practicing evil medicine, there is no way the owner of the valley wouldn't notice it."
Ning Chu thought for a while and then asked: "Yao Zun, do you think there is a possibility that a certain person in Yao Wang Valley was kicked out of Yao Wang Valley because of his evil intentions, but he got the prescription of this evil medicine by mistake before."
"I started practicing this medicine after I left Medicine King Valley, and finally let him master it?"
Pei Zhao nodded thoughtfully, he felt it made sense, "No, no, there is a section in the middle."
"This man left Yaowang Valley and moved to Jinglan. My father worshiped him as the national master."
"He wanted to use me to make elixirs, but he failed. He only started practicing this evil medicine after he escaped from Jinglan."
When this person went to Jinglan, he must not have practiced evil medicine, otherwise the whole of Jinglan would have fallen long ago.
Hearing what the two said, Yunqi, who was from Yaowang Valley, almost believed this speculation.
But he really didn't know anything. He knew nothing about whether anyone had been driven out of Yaowang Valley in the past three hundred years. There were several.
He took out a communication talisman from his storage bag, raised his hand to make a gesture to pause the discussion, turned around and left, "Wait a minute, let me ask."
Yun Qi walked towards the corner and started to contact the master of Yaowang Valley.
Everyone else found a place to sit down. When everyone looked serious, only Pei Zhao was the most open-minded and playful.
Taking advantage of the fact that no one could touch him now, he circled around Gu Xuan and patted his butt. Although he only hit air, he was very happy.
After taking the photo, he floated in front of Hou Pu and tried to pull his beard. His actions were fair and square, which made Hou Pu's eyes make a wise "Z" shape, and he didn't know whether to be angry or laugh.
Normally, if someone dared to touch his beard, he would definitely jump on his feet and curse them.
But now Pei Zhao, forget it.
Let him be, he didn't really touch it anyway.
Pei Zhao had had enough fun with Magnolia officinalis, and he boldly floated in front of Ning Xiongba, eager to try.
Ning Xiongba narrowed his eyes. He shook his head and floated back to Qin Jiu, hiding weakly behind her.
Counting birds and counting birds, you still can't be too rebellious.
Everyone in the hall felt funny when they saw him like this, and the dark clouds that had been lingering above their heads seemed to have dissipated a little.
Sure enough, it has to be Pei Zhao, who is as shameless as Ning Chu.
Even in death it was still like this, they still had to learn from him.
Seeing him like this, the sadness that he had felt because of his death improved a lot.
Love him as he pleases, at least he is still playing around in front of them, right?
But this revenge must be avenged, it must be avenged, and no one can stop them.
Just as he was thinking this, a person suddenly rushed in from outside the door, and Bao'er shouted angrily: "Where is Yunqi?!"
"Tell him to get out of here!"
She was drugged and slept until now. She felt much better, but her voice was still hoarse.
"What do you mean you drugged me? Does he want to die?!"
"I can help him!"
She held her sword, wishing she could kill Yun Qi with one sword, but he used such a despicable method to deal with her.
asshole.
Hearing Bao'er's shout, several people looked up. Ning Xiongba's face darkened, "I asked him to drug you. Do you have any objections?"
How could they just leave her in such a state? Drugging her would be the fastest and best way.
No, after sleeping, the sound was much louder.
Baoer was choked by his father, and the anger that was suppressed in his chest had nowhere to vent.
She waved her sword twice, her voice increasing instead of decreasing, "Even if, even if this is the case, you can't just drug me! You don't respect my opinion!"
